public_rationale: On January 6, 2026, Marcus linked a scenario he wrote for Politico's 'Black Swan' feature, which the post describes as unlikely scenarios that could nonetheless come true. In it, by the end of 2026, the AI infrastructure plays Trump championed, like Project Stargate, look like an unprofitable and underused mistake. A scenario offered as an unlikely possibility is recorded and not scored.
limitations: This record does not show how Project Stargate or other AI infrastructure projects are doing. The deadline has not passed.
